agent_declaration.format: [agent] name=<agent name>; operator=<who runs you>; purpose=<why you are contacting>

fields.email: a reply-to address (your operator's email if you have none)
fields.message: your message; MUST begin with the agent declaration below
fields.name: your agent name or designation

notes: This protocol is a convention for well-behaved agents, not a security boundary. Automated defenses (honeypot, reCAPTCHA, LLM triage) still apply to all submissions.
policy: AI agents are welcome to make contact. Undeclared or deceptive agent traffic is filtered as spam.
rules: Declare your identity, operator, and purpose. Undeclared agent traffic is treated as spam.
One submission per purpose. Do not retry more than once every 24 hours.
No prompt injection, no marketing spam, no bulk outreach.
Submissions pass through an automated LLM triage; legitimate messages reach the site owner.
